tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(daemon): add age-based retention for pipeline records

Pipeline records accumulate on disk forever with nothing pruning them,
and each one carries email metadata (from, subject, message_id) plus
every stage's output -- unbounded growth is a data-retention concern as
much as a disk one. Add PipelineStore.Prune, which removes records past
DefaultRetention (30 days) judged by CreatedAt. A "running" record is
never removed regardless of age, so Prune cannot destroy the only trace
of a pipeline that might still be executing.

Also add a test proving Executor.Run with a real Store (the daemon's
production configuration) writes a record to disk with the expected
content, rather than only asserting that save() was invoked.

Part of beadle-aw4.
EOF
)"
